stories.headline: Emperor Naruhito marks 66th birthday with disaster remembrance focus

stories.headline: LDP approves proposal to ease restrictions on lethal weapons exports
stories.summary: The ruling Liberal Democratic Party approved a proposal to remove restrictions limiting defense equipment transfers to non-lethal categories. The change would allow exports of fighter jets and destroyers to countries with defense cooperation agreements, marking a major shift in Japan's defense export policy.

stories.headline: Imperial family to visit Tohoku region on disaster anniversary
stories.summary: Emperor Naruhito, Empress Masako, and Princess Aiko will visit three Tohoku prefectures in March and April 2026 to mark 15 years since the Great East Japan Earthquake. The visits will focus on reconstruction progress and meeting with disaster-affected residents.

stories.headline: PM Takaichi comments on US-Israeli strikes against Iran
stories.summary: Prime Minister Takaichi held a press conference regarding the situation in Iran following US-Israeli military strikes. She emphasized that Iran's nuclear weapons development cannot be tolerated but avoided giving opinion on whether the strikes were justified.

stories.headline: PM Takaichi announces reflationist Bank of Japan board appointments
stories.summary: Prime Minister Takaichi nominated two reflationist academics to join the Bank of Japan board, signaling her pro-stimulus monetary policy stance. The appointments weakened the yen and pushed up long-term bond yields.

articles.title: Takaichi's Reflationist BOJ Picks Push Up Long-Term Bond Yields

stories.headline: Japan Innovation Party agrees to join Takaichi cabinet
stories.summary: Japan Innovation Party leader Hirofumi Yoshimura agreed to Prime Minister Takaichi's request to have a party member join her cabinet during an upcoming reshuffle. The move strengthens the ruling coalition's parliamentary position.

articles.title: Japan Innovation Party leader agrees to have a member in Takaichi Cabinet

stories.headline: LDP proposes mandatory reporting requirements for foreign agents
stories.summary: The Liberal Democratic Party drafted recommendations for examining whether existing laws are sufficient to detect foreign intelligence activities and considering new legislation requiring foreign agents to register. The proposal is part of broader counterintelligence efforts.

articles.title: LDP considers mandatory reporting by foreign agents in Japan

stories.headline: Keidanren postpones private meeting with activist investor Elliott
stories.summary: Japan's largest business lobby Keidanren postponed a scheduled private meeting with activist hedge fund Elliott Investment Management, citing 'various reasons.' The meeting was planned amid Elliott's campaigns targeting Japanese companies including Toyota.

stories.headline: Protesters rally against Takaichi's constitutional revision push
stories.summary: Large numbers of Japanese citizens gathered in Tokyo to protest Prime Minister Takaichi's attempts to revise Japan's pacifist constitution. Demonstrators expressed concern about her push for constitutional changes and increased defense spending.

articles.title: Japanese rally against PM Takaichi's attempt to revise constitution
